frame_format: Each command is sent as two bytes: [code, code XOR 0xFF]. The drone rejects any frame where the second byte is not the inverse of the first. Heartbeat (0x01) is sent at 10 Hz; if the drone hears none for 0.5 s it lands itself.
rules: A command is only sent if the smoothed match is for that gesture AND its confidence is at or above that command's min_confidence for the whole hold time.
Body gestures override hand gestures. KILL overrides everything.
NUDGE_FWD, NUDGE_BACK, YAW_360, FOLLOW_ON, FOLLOW_OFF and HOVER_LOW are ignored unless the drone is airborne.
Keyboard kill and the heartbeat failsafe work independently of gestures.

Go to 0.10 m above the floor and hold.
Tilt forward a few degrees for a short step, then re-level.
